CREATIVE ARTS — MOCK EXAM #18
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Gymnastics: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Gymnastics.
   B. Practise Gymnastics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Gymnastics.
   D. Damage equipment used for Gymnastics.

   B. Only the volume
